hypothesis: A point-in-time, provider-symbol-side triage that separates historical signal evidence, after-cost live translation, concentration, forward paths, and unresolved marks may select a more coherent portfolio successor than aggregate-PnL route ranking.
decision: Adopt the side-aware triage as the report-only successor research baseline. On the immutable v25 prefix it classifies zero of 24 routes as ready for shared-portfolio interaction, ten as REVISE, and fourteen unchanged exact contracts as STOP. STOP means the existing exact mechanic has adverse source-backed evidence and requires a genuinely new mechanic version before another confirmatory trial; it does not stop, filter, pause, resize, or alter the running v25 trial. REVISE identifies the missing experiment: side-specific mechanism separation, both-side live coverage, or source-backed mechanism evidence. A single profitable live trade cannot erase adverse development evidence, and an open marked gain cannot become a resolved outcome. Keep v25 armed and collecting both-side after-cost evidence while designing successor mechanisms rather than relaunching retired v29.
falsifier: The research process is falsified by route identity mismatch, executable authority in any input or output, an open mark affecting triage, a single live winner overriding an adverse exact-contract classification, direction evidence being collapsed, non-exclusive artifact publication, or a route satisfying the predeclared supportive-history, both-side after-cost, positive-ex-largest-winner, and independent-forward-path conditions without reaching the portfolio-interaction stage. Economic classifications update when a new immutable audit adds resolved evidence; they do not hot-mutate execution.
limitations: The triage is an evidence-routing process rather than a profitability model or an execution gate.
The historical evidence states were produced by prior heterogeneous experiments; the triage preserves their provenance but does not make their samples statistically homogeneous.
Only five compatible-profile live lifecycles are resolved, every provider-symbol has one result, and all observed sides are long.
Forward candle paths are not private fills or after-cost trades and therefore cannot independently promote a route.
The triage does not calculate Deflated Sharpe Ratio because a complete historical trial count and statistically comparable return series do not yet exist.
PROCEED means eligible for shared-portfolio interaction replay, not live promotion.
No live route, process, order, position, stop, target, allocation, transition drain, or protection changed in this revision.
